title: PIXL 8000 Cherry Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Lemonade PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod delivers a lively citrus experience balanced by a deep Cherry sweetness. The Lemonade base offers a sparkling, tangy bite, while the Cherry adds warmth and richness for a vibrant, distinctive vape that’s bursting with character. Each prefilled pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid designed for smooth satisfaction and a comfortable throat hit. Compatible exclusively with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, every pod connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically tops up the pod as you vape—delivering up to 8000 puffs per kit with no mess or refilling required. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour clarity and vapour production, while the MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw provides a crisp, satisfying, and discreet inhale ideal for everyday use.
